```{r Code for creating the tables for the top5 candidates: TableS6 and Table2, echo=FALSE}
# List to store data frames
data_list <- list()

read_and_store_data <- function(file_paths) {
  data <- read.delim(file_paths, header = TRUE)
  return(data)
}

# Read data frames and store in the list
data_list <- lapply(file_paths, read_and_store_data)
#top5_candidates

# Use lapply to apply the function to each data frame
#all_top_candidates_subsets <- lapply(data_list, get_top_candidates_subset_and_combine)
# Combine all subsets into a single data frame
#combined_data <- do.call(rbind, all_top_candidates_subsets)
#seperate the 'chr' col
#combined_top10_candidates_data<-combined_data%>% separate(chr,c('Organism','Replicon'))
#Table for Fig S6,S7

#select the top5 for fig6, supplement annotated heatmap and the crossranked tables
#top5_candidates<-subset(combined_top10_candidates_data,pr>=1 & pr<=5)
get_top_candidates_pr <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    filter(pr >= 1 & pr <= 5) %>%        # top 5 per trait
    distinct(ld_snps, .keep_all = TRUE) # remove duplicate SNPs
}

# Function to get top 5 candidates for Table 3 based on PRS + significance
get_top_candidates_prs <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    filter(prs >= 1 & prs <= 5) %>%      # top 5 cross-ranked
    filter(p_lrt <= 1e-5) %>%            # significant SNPs
    distinct(ld_snps, .keep_all = TRUE)  # remove duplicate SNPs
}

# Apply to your list of data frames
top_candidates_list_pr <- lapply(data_list, get_top_candidates_pr)
top_candidates_list_prs <- lapply(data_list, get_top_candidates_prs)

# Combine all traits
combined_top5 <- bind_rows(top_candidates_list_pr)
combined_top5_prs <- bind_rows(top_candidates_list_prs)
#TableS7
write.table(combined_top5,file="../Tables/strainfitness/top5candidates.tsv",sep = "\t",row.names = FALSE) 


#Table3
write.table(combined_top5_prs,file="../Tables/strainfitness/top5candidates_prs.tsv",sep = "\t",row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r Code for finding common and unique SNPS, echo=FALSE}
 library(ggplot2)
 library(ggrepel)
 
 # Assume your columns are: # beta_reference: effect size in reference (A17)
 # beta_mutant: effect size in mutant
 # Gene: candidate gene name
library(ggrepel)
# 5. Split Reference (A17) vs Mutants
# -----------------------------
# Split data by host type
reference_snps <- combined_top5 %>% filter(run == "A17")
mutant_snps    <- combined_top5 %>% filter(run != "A17")

# Find common SNPs (present in both A17 and at least one mutant host)
common_ids <- intersect(reference_snps$ld_snps, mutant_snps$ld_snps)

# Filter only those from the combined dataset
common_snps <- combined_top5 %>% 
  filter(ld_snps %in% common_ids)

# Write to file
write.table(common_snps,
            file = "../Tables/strainfitness/common_snps.tsv",
            sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)

##Unique SNPs per host mutant

unique_mutant_snps <- anti_join(
  mutant_snps, reference_snps,
  by = "ld_snps"
)

# Write out the result
dir.create("../Tables/strainfitness", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
write.table(unique_mutant_snps,
            file = "../Tables/strainfitness/unique_mutant_snps.tsv",
            sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)


##Unique SNPs to strain fitness and strain fitness shift
df1 <- read.table("../Tables/strainfitness/top5candidates.tsv", sep="\t", header=TRUE)
df1<-df1%>% filter(run != "A17")
df2 <- read.table("../Tables/TableS6.tsv", sep="\t", header=TRUE)
df2<-df2%>% filter(run != "A17")

# Unique to df1
unique_df1 <- anti_join(df1, df2, by = "ld_snps")

# Unique to df2
unique_df2 <- anti_join(df2, df1, by = "ld_snps")

dir.create("../Tables/strainfitness", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

write.table(unique_df1,
            file = "../Tables/strainfitness/unique_in_strainfitness.tsv",
            sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)

write.table(unique_df2,
            file = "../Tables/strainfitness/unique_in_strainfitnessshift.tsv",
            sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)


common_snps.1 <- inner_join(df1, df2, by = "ld_snps")
common_snps.1 <- df1 %>% 
  filter(ld_snps %in% df2$ld_snps)
write.table(common_snps.1,
             file = "../Tables/strainfitness/common_snps_strainfitness_strainfitnessshift.tsv",
            sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)
# Count SNPs in each category
count_common_host      <- nrow(common_snps)
count_unique_mutant    <- nrow(unique_mutant_snps)
count_unique_df1       <- nrow(unique_df1)
count_unique_df2       <- nrow(unique_df2)
count_common_strainfit <- nrow(common_snps.1)

# NEW: Total SNP counts in each dataset (common + unique)
count_total_df1 <- nrow(df1)
count_total_df2 <- nrow(df2)

# Combine into a summary table
counts_summary <- data.frame(
  Category = c("Common_between_hosts_strainfitness",
               "Unique_to_mutants_strainfitness",
               "Unique_to_strainfitness_wrt_straifitnessshift",
               "Unique_to_strainfitnessshift_wrt_strainfitness",
               "Common_between_strainfitness_and_shift",
               "Total_strainfitness_SNPs",
               "Total_strainfitnessshift_SNPs"),
  Count = c(count_common_host,
            count_unique_mutant,
            count_unique_df1,
            count_unique_df2,
            count_common_strainfit,
            count_total_df1,
            count_total_df2)
)

# Print to console
print(counts_summary)

# Write to file
write.table(counts_summary,
            file = "../Tables/strainfitness/snp_counts_summary.tsv",
            sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)
library(dplyr)
# Total ld_groups in strain fitness
total_ld_df1 <- df1 %>% summarise(Total_ld_group = n_distinct(ld_group)) %>% pull()

# Total ld_groups in strain fitness shift
total_ld_df2 <- df2 %>% summarise(Total_ld_group = n_distinct(ld_group)) %>% pull()

# Print results
cat("Total ld_groups in strain fitness (df1):", total_ld_df1, "\n")
cat("Total ld_groups in strain fitness shift (df2):", total_ld_df2, "\n")
# 1. Common SNPs between hosts
count_ld_common_host <- common_snps %>% summarise(Count_ld_group = n_distinct(ld_group)) %>% pull()

# 2. Unique SNPs in mutant hosts
count_ld_unique_mutant <- unique_mutant_snps %>% summarise(Count_ld_group = n_distinct(ld_group)) %>% pull()

# 3. Unique to df1 (strainfitness wrt shift)
count_ld_unique_df1 <- unique_df1 %>% summarise(Count_ld_group = n_distinct(ld_group)) %>% pull()

# 4. Unique to df2 (strainfitness shift wrt df1)
count_ld_unique_df2 <- unique_df2 %>% summarise(Count_ld_group = n_distinct(ld_group)) %>% pull()

# 5. Common between df1 and df2
count_ld_common_strainfit <- common_snps.1 %>% summarise(Count_ld_group = n_distinct(ld_group)) %>% pull()

# Combine counts into a summary table
ld_group_summary <- data.frame(
  Category = c("Total ld_group in strainfitness","Total ld_group in strainfitnessshift","Common_between_hosts_strainfitness",
               "Unique_to_mutants_strainfitness",
               "Unique_to_strainfitness_wrt_strainfitnessshift",
               "Unique_to_strainfitnessshift_wrt_strainfitness",
               "Common_between_strainfitness_and_shift"),
  Count_ld_group = c(total_ld_df1,total_ld_df2,count_ld_common_host,
                     count_ld_unique_mutant,
                     count_ld_unique_df1,
                     count_ld_unique_df2,
                     count_ld_common_strainfit)
)

# Print to console
print(ld_group_summary)

# Write to file
write.table(ld_group_summary,
            file = "../Tables/strainfitness/ld_group_counts_summary.tsv",
            sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)
```

```{r Code for manhattanplots for paper, echo=FALSE}

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

data_list_named <- Map(function(df, file) {
    df <- df %>%
        mutate(
            Chromosome = sapply(strsplit(chr, "-"), `[`, 2),  # extract part after '-'
            Position = ldg                                      # rename ldg to Position
        )
     
     df$Trait <- gsub(".*_trait_|\\.tsv$", "", basename(file))  # extract trait from filename
    return(df)
 }, data_list, file_paths)


 combined_gwas <- bind_rows(data_list_named)

# Now select and pivot
gwas_wide <- combined_gwas %>%
    dplyr::select(ldg, Chromosome, ps, Trait, p_lrt) %>%  # use actual column names
   distinct() %>% pivot_wider(
         names_from = Trait,
        values_from = p_lrt,
    )
 # Optional: rename ldg to LD_group
gwas_wide <- gwas_wide %>% rename(SNP = ldg, Position=ps)
desired_order <- c("Chromosome","SNP", "Position",
                   "A17", "dnf1", "dnf1dnf2", "dnf2", "dnf3", "dnf4",
                   "dnf5dnf2", "dnf6", "dnf7",
                   "hcl", "ipd3", "latd", "nad1", "rdn1", "sunn1", "sunn4")

gwas_wide <- gwas_wide[, desired_order]
gwas_wide$Chromosome <- factor(gwas_wide$Chromosome,
                               levels = c("chr", "pSymA", "pSymB"))

# (Optional) Check to confirm
levels(gwas_wide$Chromosome)

 # Check result
head(gwas_wide)
colnames(gwas_wide)
figures <- "/Users/sohiniguha/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-ThePennsylvaniaStateUniversity/Sohini_Liana/GitHub/HostMutants2021_C86meliloti/strainfitness/figures"
# -----------------------------
# 0️⃣ Define colors for traits
colors_16 <- c("#0000ff", "#000000", "#5C5A5A", "#feb300", "#00aeae", "#ffff00", "#F5E4E4", "#ff4600", 
                "#53a1f0", "#e9c6ac", "#9d22f3", "#3d389a", "#95ef57", "#f311c1", "#0a82f0", "#cd93aa") 

# -----------------------------
# 1️⃣ Extract trait names from first row (columns 5:20)
trait_names <- colnames(gwas_wide)[4:19]

# -----------------------------
# 2️⃣ Remove first row (only contains trait names)
data_clean <- gwas_wide[-1, ]

# -----------------------------
# 3️⃣ Convert trait columns to numeric
data_clean[, 4:19] <- lapply(data_clean[, 4:19], function(x) as.numeric(as.character(x)))

# Optional: check for NAs
if(any(is.na(data_clean[, 4:19]))) {
  warning("Some trait columns contain NA values after conversion.")
}

# -----------------------------
# 4️⃣ Assign trait names as column names
colnames(data_clean)[4:19] <- trait_names

# -----------------------------
# 5️⃣ Ensure Position is numeric
data_clean$Position <- as.numeric(as.character(data_clean$Position))

# -----------------------------
# 6️⃣ Map Chromosome based on SNP names
data_clean$Chromosome <- ifelse(
  grepl("chr", data_clean$SNP, ignore.case = TRUE), "chr",
  ifelse(grepl("psyma", data_clean$SNP, ignore.case = TRUE), "pSymA",
         ifelse(grepl("psymb", data_clean$SNP, ignore.case = TRUE), "pSymB", NA))
)

# -----------------------------
# 7️⃣ Build cmdata for CMplot
cmdata <- data_clean[, c("SNP", "Chromosome", "Position", trait_names)]
cmdata$Chromosome <- factor(cmdata$Chromosome,
                               levels = c("chr", "pSymA", "pSymB"))
cmdata <- cmdata[order(cmdata$Chromosome, cmdata$Position), ]
# -----------------------------
# 8️⃣ Plot with CMplot
CMplot(cmdata,
       plot.type="m",
       col="grey",
       multraits=TRUE,
       threshold=1e-5,
       threshold.lty=2,
       threshold.lwd=1.5,
       threshold.col="black",
       amplify=TRUE,
       chr.den.col=NULL,
       signal.col=colors_16,
       signal.cex=1,
       file="jpg",
       file.name="Strainfitness_manhattanplot",
       dpi=300,
       file.output=TRUE,
       verbose=TRUE,
       points.alpha=225,  # integer 0-255
       legend.ncol=3,
       legend.pos="middle")


##Q-Qplot 
CMplot(cmdata,
       plot.type="q",
       col=colors_16,
       multraits=TRUE,
       conf.int=FALSE,
       box=FALSE,
       axis.cex=1,
       file="jpg",
       file.name="Strainfitness_output_file_qq",  # saves as qq.jpg
       dpi=300,
       file.output=TRUE,
       verbose=TRUE,
       ylim=c(0,12),
       width=7,
       height=7)

```
